scope: The supplied ultimate research pipeline applied to the actual FREM evidence; closed exploratory studies and canonical confirmation are distinct.
terminal_conclusion: S8 predictive practical-support requirement is unmet and the predefined positive-effect classification remains INCONCLUSIVE; the economic point-win gate and the requested 6 percent uplift fail. No new data access or repeated fitting is justified by a requirement to make the result positive.

gates.new_successor: PROPOSED_ONLY: horizon-matched economic question and falsifiers specified, no mature effect or eligible outer dataset yet.

gates.new_successor: NOT_READY: exact formulas, scenario construction, tolerances and dataset dates must be fixed before implementation/freeze.

gates.new_successor: NO_NEW_SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE: diagnosis or specification is not a new empirical experiment.

gates.name: VERIFIED
gates.current_study: PARTIAL: same-host engineering and saved-output checks passed; independent clean-environment major-model retraining remains separate and unperformed.

gates.name: RESEARCH COMPLETE
gates.current_study: S8 bounded exploratory question has a defensible terminal conclusion. Full canonical empirical, independently reproduced and publication-ready package is not established by that conclusion alone.
gates.new_successor: NO: a proposal does not reset history or satisfy a full pipeline.

finishing_rule: Finish the local evidence/manuscript/reproducibility package with the honest terminal result. Do not reopen a valid negative/inconclusive study merely to pass a target. Broader datasets, independent retraining, mandate execution and external submission remain separately identified requirements.
